title: GH-12: Reset main to specification-only state (v0 conformance)
description:
The main branch currently contains both human-written specifications and Claude-generated Go code. Per the v0/v1 tagging convention described in the README, the main branch should be a specification-only baseline between generation runs.

The most recent generation run (documented in eng04) produced 4,586 lines of Go across 22 files and tagged the result as v1.20260225.2. However, the generated code was never removed from main afterward. The current v0.20260225.0 tag was created on a commit that still contains generated code, which contradicts the v0 convention.

GitHub: petar-djukic/go-unix-utils#12

title: Implement pkg/format column alignment, ANSI color, and human-readable size (prd003-format R1, R2, R3)
description:
deliverable_type: code

required_reading:
  - docs/specs/product-requirements/prd003-format.yaml (full PRD for pkg/format -- column alignment, ANSI color, human-readable size)
  - docs/specs/product-requirements/prd002-sys.yaml (pkg/sys API -- IsTerminal used by ColorEnabled)
  - pkg/sys/terminal.go (IsTerminal function signature and implementation)
  - docs/ARCHITECTURE.yaml (pkg/format component description and technology choices)
  - docs/specs/dependency-map.yaml (confirms ls and du are the consumers of pkg/format)

files:
  - path: pkg/format/columns.go
    action: create
    note: "Columns, PadRight, PadLeft, displayWidth -- column alignment primitives for ls multi-column layout"
  - path: pkg/format/color.go
    action: create
    note: "FileTypeColor, Reset, ColorEnabled -- ANSI color output with TTY-aware suppression"
  - path: pkg/format/humansize.go
    action: create
    note: "HumanSize, HumanSizeOpts -- byte-to-human-readable conversion for ls -h and du -h"

requirements:
  - id: R1
    text: "Implement Columns(entries []string, termWidth int) [][]string that distributes entries into the maximum number of columns fitting within termWidth. Column widths are computed from the longest entry in each column, not the global maximum. Entries are distributed vertically (down columns, then across). Per prd003-format R1.1, R1.4."
  - id: R2
    text: "Implement PadRight(s string, width int) string and PadLeft(s string, width int) string for left-aligned and right-aligned field padding within a fixed-width column. Padding is computed from display width, not byte count. Per prd003-format R1.2."
  - id: R3
    text: "Compute column display width from rune count, not byte count, so multi-byte Unicode characters are measured correctly. Per prd003-format R1.3."
  - id: R4
    text: "Implement FileTypeColor(mode os.FileMode) string returning the ANSI escape sequence for a file's type, and a Reset constant or function returning the ANSI reset sequence (\"\\033[0m\"). Use GNU ls LS_COLORS default color assignments: directory=34 (blue), symlink=36 (cyan), executable=32 (green), block device=33;1 (yellow bold), char device=33;1 (yellow bold), socket=35 (magenta), pipe=33 (yellow), regular=0 (default). Per prd003-format R2.1, R2.2, R2.4."
  - id: R5
    text: "Implement ColorEnabled(w io.Writer) bool that returns true only when w is a TTY. Delegate the TTY check to pkg/sys.IsTerminal (prd002-sys R1.3). When ColorEnabled returns false, FileTypeColor must return an empty string and Reset must return an empty string. Per prd003-format R2.3."
  - id: R6
    text: "Implement HumanSize(bytes int64, opts HumanSizeOpts) string that converts a byte count to a human-readable string. HumanSizeOpts supports two modes: binary (1024-based, suffixes K/M/G/T/P/E, default) and SI (1000-based, suffixes kB/MB/GB/TB). Format to at most one decimal place when the value is not an integer at the chosen unit (e.g., 1536 -> \"1.5K\"). Return \"0\" for zero byte count regardless of mode. Per prd003-format R3.1, R3.2, R3.3, R3.4."

design_decisions:
  - id: D1
    text: "ColorEnabled delegates TTY detection to pkg/sys.IsTerminal (prd003-format R2.3). Must not import golang.org/x/term; pkg/sys uses golang.org/x/sys/unix for the TIOCGWINSZ ioctl check (prd002-sys R1.3)."
  - id: D2
    text: "Color assignments use GNU ls LS_COLORS defaults exactly as specified in prd003-format R2.4. No LS_COLORS environment variable parsing (prd003-format non-goals)."
  - id: D3
    text: "Columns computes per-column widths from the longest entry in each column, not the global maximum (prd003-format R1.4). This matches GNU ls multi-column layout behavior."
  - id: D4
    text: "File organization mirrors the three capability areas in the PRD: columns.go for column alignment (R1), color.go for ANSI color (R2), humansize.go for size conversion (R3). The package declaration is 'package format' per ARCHITECTURE.yaml project_structure."
  - id: D5
    text: "ColorEnabled uses an io.Writer parameter. To extract the file descriptor for IsTerminal, type-assert to *os.File. When the assertion fails (e.g., bufio.Writer wrapping a non-file), return false. This matches the expected usage pattern where stdout is passed directly."

acceptance_criteria:
  - id: AC1
    text: "Columns(entries, 80) with a list of entries produces a [][]string where each row fits within 80 characters and the number of columns is maximized."
  - id: AC2
    text: "PadRight(\"abc\", 10) returns \"abc       \" (7 trailing spaces). PadLeft(\"42\", 6) returns \"    42\" (4 leading spaces)."
  - id: AC3
    text: "FileTypeColor returns the correct ANSI escape sequence for each of the eight file types: directory (\\033[34m), symlink (\\033[36m), executable (\\033[32m), block device (\\033[33;1m), char device (\\033[33;1m), socket (\\033[35m), pipe (\\033[33m), regular (empty string)."
  - id: AC4
    text: "ColorEnabled returns false when passed an io.Writer backed by an os.Pipe (not a TTY). FileTypeColor returns empty string and Reset returns empty string when color is not enabled."
  - id: AC5
    text: "HumanSize(1536, HumanSizeOpts{Binary: true}) returns \"1.5K\". HumanSize(1000000, HumanSizeOpts{SI: true}) returns \"1.0MB\". HumanSize(0, HumanSizeOpts{}) returns \"0\". HumanSize(1024, HumanSizeOpts{Binary: true}) returns \"1.0K\"."
  - id: AC6
    text: "All pkg/format code compiles on both darwin/arm64 and linux/amd64 with no build errors, no cgo, and no warnings under golangci-lint."
  - id: AC7
    text: "go vet ./pkg/format/... passes with no errors."

title: GH-18: Benchmark generation runs: default vs include-all vs exclude-all file contexts
description:
Run three generation passes with different configuration.yaml context-file settings and compare the results across token cost, wall-clock time, and code quality.

Variants:
1. Default files — no explicit include/exclude (use whatever the current default provides)
2. Include all files — explicitly include every file in the repo
3. Exclude all files — explicitly exclude every file so the model starts with no repo context

Metrics: token usage (input + output), wall-clock time, quality of generated code (test pass rate, lint cleanliness, spec conformance). For variant 3: which files does Claude request during generation, and in what order?

GitHub: petar-djukic/go-unix-utils#18

title: Document experiment protocol
description:
Required Reading: docs/engineering/eng04-generation-run-results.yaml, configuration.yaml, docs/ARCHITECTURE.yaml
Files to Create: docs/engineering/eng05-context-benchmark-protocol.yaml

Requirements:
- Define the three variants and their exact configuration.yaml settings:
  - Variant 1 (default): context_sources="", context_include="", context_exclude=""
  - Variant 2 (include-all): context_include set to glob that captures every file in the repo
  - Variant 3 (exclude-all): context_exclude set to "."
- Specify target scope: same utilities as eng04 (ts, cat, wc, sponge, testutils, sys, format)
- Define metrics: token cost (input/output/cache), wall-clock time, LOC, quality (compile, vet, test pass rate)
- For variant 3: define how to capture Claude's file requests from stitch logs
- Document the branching strategy (one generation per variant)

Acceptance Criteria:
- Protocol is reproducible by another operator
- All three variants are unambiguous in their configuration.yaml changes

title: pkg/sys: implement terminal width, extended file metadata, and signal handling (prd002-sys R1-R4)
description:
deliverable_type: code

required_reading:
  - docs/specs/product-requirements/prd002-sys.yaml (full PRD for pkg/sys -- all requirements and acceptance criteria)
  - docs/ARCHITECTURE.yaml (pkg/sys component description and technology choices)
  - docs/specs/product-requirements/prd003-format.yaml (R2.3 references pkg/sys.IsTerminal for ColorEnabled)
  - go.mod (verify golang.org/x/sys dependency is declared as the only external dependency)
  - cmd/cat/main.go (existing inline SIGPIPE handling pattern at lines 49-54 that pkg/sys.InstallSIGPIPEHandler will replace)

files:
  - path: pkg/sys/terminal.go
    action: create
    note: TerminalWidth and IsTerminal functions using golang.org/x/sys/unix
  - path: pkg/sys/fileinfo.go
    action: create
    note: FileInfo struct definition, Stat and Lstat wrapper functions
  - path: pkg/sys/stat_darwin.go
    action: create
    note: Darwin-specific stat field extraction (st_mtimespec, st_blocks interpretation)
  - path: pkg/sys/stat_linux.go
    action: create
    note: Linux-specific stat field extraction (st_mtim, st_blocks interpretation)
  - path: pkg/sys/signal.go
    action: create
    note: InstallSIGPIPEHandler and OnTerminalResize functions

requirements:
  - id: R1
    text: "Implement TerminalWidth() (int, error) that returns the current terminal column count by calling ioctl(TIOCGWINSZ) on stdout using golang.org/x/sys/unix. Must return an error (not panic) when stdout is not a terminal or when ioctl fails. Per prd002-sys R1.1-R1.2."
  - id: R2
    text: "Implement IsTerminal(fd uintptr) bool that returns true when the file descriptor refers to a terminal. Required by pkg/format (prd003-format R2.3) for ColorEnabled. Use golang.org/x/sys/unix for the check; must not import golang.org/x/term. Per prd002-sys R1.3."
  - id: R3
    text: "Define a FileInfo struct containing all fields from prd002-sys R2.2: Mode (os.FileMode), Size (int64), Nlink (uint64), Uid (uint32), Gid (uint32), Rdev (uint64), Dev (uint64), Ino (uint64), Blocks (int64), Blksize (int64), ModTime (time.Time), and the underlying os.FileInfo for compatibility with os package functions."
  - id: R4
    text: "Implement Stat(path string) (*FileInfo, error) and Lstat(path string) (*FileInfo, error) that call os.Stat/os.Lstat and extract extended fields from the underlying syscall.Stat_t via a platform-specific extraction function. Per prd002-sys R2.1."
  - id: R5
    text: "Abstract the Darwin/Linux divergence in syscall.Stat_t field names using build-tagged source files: st_mtimespec on Darwin vs st_mtim on Linux, and platform-specific st_blocks interpretation. Per prd002-sys R2.3."
  - id: R6
    text: "Implement InstallSIGPIPEHandler() that installs a signal handler calling os.Exit(0) on SIGPIPE. Must not use signal.Ignore; must install a handler so deferred cleanup functions do not run, matching GNU behavior. Per prd002-sys R3.1-R3.2."
  - id: R7
    text: "Implement OnTerminalResize(callback func(width int)) that registers a SIGWINCH handler. When the terminal is resized, the handler calls TerminalWidth() and invokes the callback with the new width. Must support multiple calls to OnTerminalResize; each registered callback must be called on resize. Per prd002-sys R4.1-R4.2."

design_decisions:
  - id: D1
    text: "Use golang.org/x/sys/unix for TIOCGWINSZ ioctl. Must not shell out to tput or stty. Must not import golang.org/x/term. Per prd002-sys R1.3."
  - id: D2
    text: "Use Go build tags (//go:build darwin and //go:build linux) for platform-specific stat field extraction. fileinfo.go defines the FileInfo struct and Stat/Lstat functions which call a platform-specific extractStatFields function defined in stat_darwin.go and stat_linux.go. Per prd002-sys R2.3."
  - id: D3
    text: "InstallSIGPIPEHandler must install a signal handler that calls os.Exit(0) on SIGPIPE so deferred cleanup functions do not run, matching GNU behavior where SIGPIPE terminates silently. Must not use signal.Ignore. Per prd002-sys R3.2."
  - id: D4
    text: "Lstat on a symlink must return the symlink's own st_mode with type bits showing symlink, not the target's mode. Per prd002-sys AC3."
  - id: D5
    text: "No cgo dependency. All syscall access uses golang.org/x/sys/unix which provides pure-Go implementations. Must compile on both darwin/arm64 and linux/amd64 with no cgo. Per prd002-sys AC5."

acceptance_criteria:
  - id: AC1
    text: "TerminalWidth() compiles and returns (int, error). When stdout is not a terminal, it returns a non-nil error. Per prd002-sys AC1."
  - id: AC2
    text: "Stat() and Lstat() return *FileInfo with correct Nlink, Uid, Gid, Dev, Ino, Blocks, Blksize, Rdev, Mode, Size, and ModTime fields populated from syscall.Stat_t. Per prd002-sys AC2."
  - id: AC3
    text: "Lstat() on a symlink returns FileInfo with Mode type bits showing symlink, not the target's mode. Per prd002-sys AC3."
  - id: AC4
    text: "InstallSIGPIPEHandler() registers a handler that calls os.Exit(0) when SIGPIPE is received. Per prd002-sys AC4."
  - id: AC5
    text: "OnTerminalResize registers callbacks that are invoked with the new terminal width when SIGWINCH is received. Multiple callbacks can be registered via successive calls. Per prd002-sys R4.1-R4.2."
  - id: AC6
    text: "All pkg/sys code compiles on both darwin/arm64 and linux/amd64 with no build errors and no cgo. Per prd002-sys AC5."
  - id: AC7
    text: "All pkg/sys code compiles with no warnings under golangci-lint. Per prd002-sys AC6."
